report.summary: Plan: 4 items to fix race condition in killswitch, implement check logic, verify forest assumptions, and add foreign key validation. Depends on inspecting full files.
risks: Race condition fix may introduce new timing issues.
Check logic implementation may be complex and require careful design.
Forest assumptions may be violated, requiring changes in dss/graph modules.
Foreign key validation may require schema migration.
todos: Open full daedalus/lanes/checks.py and search for functions using elision_markers, min_size_ratio, min_symbol_survival.
Open daedalus/killswitch.py and daedalus/attempt.py to understand race condition.
Inspect dss._estimated_tokens and graph.fenced_dominance for type node filtering.
Check daedalus/memory/embeddings.py for foreign key enforcement.
Write tests for each item after implementation.

items.title: Fix race condition in killswitch that produces fabricated 'gates_failed' verdicts
items.why_now: Critical severity: fabricated verdicts pollute evaluation metrics and picker scoring, undermining the entire evaluation pipeline. This is a confirmed bug that must be fixed before any end-to-end vertical slice.

steps.do: Open daedalus/killswitch.py and daedalus/attempt.py to understand the race condition in _watch_loop.
steps.verified_by: Read the code and confirm the race condition described.

steps.do: Modify killswitch._watch_loop to atomically check cancellation before recording 'gates_failed'.
steps.verified_by: grep for cancellation check before gates_failed assignment.

steps.do: Write a test that simulates the race: start killswitch, cancel gate process, verify attempt.py records 'cancelled' not 'gates_failed'.
steps.verified_by: Run pytest tests/test_killswitch_race.py and see it pass.

items.assumption: The race condition is as described and reproducible.

items.title: Implement missing check logic in checks.py using defined CheckPolicy fields
items.why_now: High severity: the CheckPolicy fields exist but the logic that uses them is missing, meaning the check mechanism is incomplete. This blocks the first end-to-end vertical slice because write lanes depend on these checks.

steps.do: Open full daedalus/lanes/checks.py and search for functions that use elision_markers, min_size_ratio, or min_symbol_survival.
steps.verified_by: Grep for those field names in the file; if no usage found, proceed.

steps.do: Implement check functions that use the fields, e.g., check_elision, check_truncation, check_symbol_survival.
steps.verified_by: Run existing tests and new tests that exercise these checks.

steps.do: Add tests for each new check function.

items.assumption: The implementation does not exist elsewhere in the file or in another module.

items.title: Verify and enforce forest assumptions about type nodes in dss and graph modules
items.why_now: High severity: if dss._estimated_tokens or graph.fenced_dominance include type nodes, token budgets and routing decisions may be incorrect. This is a needs-evidence finding that must be resolved to ensure correctness of the forest module.

steps.do: Inspect dss._estimated_tokens to see if it filters out type nodes.
steps.verified_by: Grep for 'type' or node kind filtering in the function.

steps.do: Inspect graph.fenced_dominance to see if it filters out type nodes.
steps.verified_by: Grep for 'type' or node kind filtering in the function.

steps.do: If either includes type nodes, modify them to exclude type nodes per forest.py contract.
steps.verified_by: Tests pass and forest assumptions are satisfied.

items.assumption: The exact file paths for dss and graph modules are unknown; need to locate them. This step is blocked on finding those files.

items.title: Add foreign key validation in record_journal_watermark or schema
items.why_now: Medium severity: orphaned watermarks are possible if no foreign key constraint exists. This could lead to data integrity issues. Prefer to fix early before data accumulates.

steps.do: Open daedalus/memory/embeddings.py and check if record_journal_watermark has a foreign key check or if schema enforces FK.
steps.verified_by: grep for 'foreign key' or similar in the file and schema.

steps.do: If missing, add a foreign key constraint in the database schema or add explicit validation in the function.
steps.verified_by: Run tests and verify no orphaned rows.

items.assumption: The database schema file is known and modifiable.
